_comment: Provider behaviour capabilities read by tools/lib/review-capabilities.sh (ai-review-preflight, ai-review-lifecycle). The old shared review runner and its door scripts were deleted in #2074; second opinions use bin/ai-second-opinion.

capabilities._comment: Behaviour capabilities (#1834). Shared review layers never decide whether an evidence, receipt, record, cleanup or qualification step happens by provider name; they read the named field here through tools/lib/review-capabilities.sh. Absent or false means the common path. Provider policy data (timeouts, budgets, routes, platform guards) stays in code. Inventory: docs/reviewer-harness-consolidation.md.
